_comment: Copy this file to devices.json and edit. devices.json is the one the bridge reads.
_tokens: Leave blank and the bridge generates one on first run and prints it. Paste the apiToken into AMAYA ERP -> Settings -> Devices.
_serial: sn can stay blank. The bridge detects it on first poll and remembers it. Set it explicitly only if your terminal reports a different one.
_path: If your terminals sit behind a subpath, set it here, e.g. "/zkteco".
